storyline.real: On a wet, low-grip Istanbul Park, Hamilton starts sixth, runs his worn intermediates to the flag without another stop and wins by 31.6 s, securing his seventh title.

mastery.label: Win pushing for no more than 8 laps

eras.briefing: Istanbul, 2020. A wet track on a smooth new surface with little grip, and Hamilton starts sixth. You run him, fifth after 26 laps on a worn set of tyres, 13.6 s behind the leader Stroll. Win, and the title is his.
